sources.title: Training SpaceInvadersNoFrameskip with DQN | SERP AI
sources.snippet: To evaluate the model's performance, users typically run the enjoyment script provided with the RL Zoo framework: python -m rl_zoo3.enjoy --algo dqn --env SpaceInvadersNoFrameskip-v4 -f logs/. This command executes the trained policy in the environment, allowing for direct observation of the agent's gameplay.
